message:
I remember the first time we had a blackout that lasted longer than a couple of hours. It was a warm summer evening, and I had just finished prepping dinner when—boom!—the lights went out. My partner looked at me, eyebrows raised, and I couldn't help but smirk a little because I had insisted on charging our power banks and gathering flashlights earlier that week. 

We turned on our trusty lanterns and settled in for a cozy night, playing card games and eating leftovers by the soft glow. It felt like a mini adventure! 

I know it can seem like a hassle to prepare for something that might never happen, but that night, I felt a little smug knowing I had thought ahead. Have you ever had a moment like that? What’s your favorite tip for staying comfortable during a blackout? 😊
